title: Explicabilidad, equidad e incertidumbre
scope: LESSONS_ONLY: title/tagline/job relevance, 8 outcomes, 33/33 theory/reference paragraphs, 8 theory code/output blocks, 9 callouts, 1 figure, plus the S35-specific interactive playground rendered inside Theory. I Do / We Do / You Do / self-check / exams excluded.

live_status.public_card_tagline: Ficha de caso que distingue evidencia observada, contribución del modelo, incertidumbre y decisión humana
live_status.reason: The available public crawl is roughly four weeks old; the 18h vs 9h mismatch is not promoted to a deployment defect without a fresh hydrated render.

research_basis.use: Requires a fitted model, baseline score, repeated permutations; held-out/CV evaluation recommended; correlated features can mislead.
Fairness assessment starts from harms and groups, then disaggregated metrics; MetricFrame is based on y_true/y_pred/sensitive_features and supports uncertainty.
Classification conformal produces prediction sets with marginal coverage under exchangeability; conformalization data are distinct from base-model fit.
Explanations should be meaningful, accurate to the system process, and respect knowledge limits.
Model cards document intended use, evaluation conditions/performance and broader model reporting; four S35 fields are only a lab subset.

rejected_findings.claim: Legacy system-design id still renders the old ADR/system-design playground.
rejected_findings.evidence: Current SectionView mapping for system-design is 'Practica la ficha de caso CP-N3-C', so the historical ADR P0 is stale.

rejected_findings.claim: The local value×weight lab falsely claims to be SHAP/LIME.
rejected_findings.evidence: Source explicitly says it is neither SHAP nor LIME; the actual defect is lack of binding/fidelity to a real model prediction.

rejected_findings.claim: The p±q toy band is presented as real conformal coverage.
rejected_findings.evidence: Source explicitly marks level='toy' and coverage_claim=False; the defect is using a decorative band as a required uncertainty gate.

rejected_findings.claim: min_n=30 is asserted as a universal fairness standard.
rejected_findings.evidence: Source explicitly labels min_n=30 as lab policy, not a universal statistical standard.

rejected_findings.claim: Permutation importance is presented as intrinsic feature truth.
rejected_findings.evidence: Source already warns it depends on metric and collinearity.

rejected_findings.claim: low_n is said to prove inequity.
rejected_findings.evidence: Source explicitly says low_n does not prove inequity or parity.

rejected_findings.claim: The four-layer figure is off-topic or conceptually broken.
rejected_findings.evidence: The figure correctly separates evidence, model contribution, uncertainty and human decision; OOD reason belongs under uncertainty.

rejected_findings.claim: 18h live versus 9h source is a confirmed deployment defect.
rejected_findings.evidence: Public crawl is stale; needs a fresh hydrated render before promotion.

findings.summary: S35 consumes S34 scores/metrics/policies as if validated although S34 remains REPAIR_REQUIRED.
findings.fix: Require a machine-valid frozen S34 prediction/policy artifact before S35 analysis.

findings.summary: jobRelevance calls the work queue a 'cola de fraude', reframing the inherited needs_review target as fraud.
findings.fix: Call it cola de revisión/triage and keep fraud outside target semantics.

findings.summary: No explanation/fairness/uncertainty artifact is bound to sample_id, model/run, feature-set, split, target, horizon, policy or evidence provenance.
findings.fix: Introduce a versioned CaseExplanation/PredictionRow lineage contract.

findings.summary: means_fraud=False, causal=False and auto_fraud=False are hard-coded booleans, not validators of prose/actions/labels.
findings.fix: Validate structured claims/actions and reject forbidden semantics.

findings.summary: The opening states that an unfamiliar case's correct answer is abstention as a universal truth.
findings.fix: Frame abstention/escalation as the lab's fail-closed policy when a validated knowledge-limit condition fires.

findings.summary: Outcome says calculate permutation importance, but canonical code only sorts externally supplied drops.
findings.fix: Compute baseline and permuted scores from a fitted frozen model and evaluation rows.

findings.summary: Permutation importance lacks an evaluated fitted model, held-out dataset, repeated shuffles, variability and row/run provenance.
findings.fix: Use frozen candidate, held-out/CV data, n_repeats and mean/std evidence.

findings.summary: rank_by_drop crashes on empty drops, accepts NaN as top feature and has undocumented insertion-order tie break.
findings.fix: Validate non-empty finite drops and define deterministic ties.

findings.summary: Coefficient interpretation omits the model/output scale; logistic coefficients operate on log-odds, not probability.
findings.fix: State exact link/output scale and feature scaling before magnitude interpretation.

findings.summary: value×weight is not bound to a fitted model, transformed row or actual prediction and never verifies additivity/explanation accuracy.
findings.fix: Bind to one frozen model/input and verify baseline+sum(contrib) against actual output in declared space.

findings.summary: T1-B promises a four-layer case card, but canonical theory code returns only contributions, a score and causal=False.
findings.fix: Build and validate all four layers in canonical T1-B evidence.

findings.summary: Theory playground labels derived features ['shared_phone','amount_z_high'] as observed evidence.
findings.fix: Use source-record/evidence IDs in evidence layer and keep derived features in model layer.

findings.summary: Slice metrics are hand-written aggregates and compared=True, not derived from frozen prediction rows.
findings.fix: Compute per-slice metrics from keyed out-of-sample rows.

findings.summary: Total n is treated as minimum fairness evidence while metric-specific denominators, prevalence/support and uncertainty are absent.
findings.fix: Report confusion/support/prevalence and CI/equivalent uncertainty per slice.

findings.summary: Prose moves from group metric gaps to unequal harm without first defining harm, affected groups and fairness question.
findings.fix: Start with harm/group/context, then choose disaggregated metrics and uncertainty.

findings.summary: slice_flag accepts negative/fractional counts and classifies NaN as ok_n.
findings.fix: Require finite non-negative integer support and fail closed on invalid n.

findings.summary: tag_from_evidence receives n_by_group but ignores it; tiny groups can be tagged high.
findings.fix: Validate group support/uncertainty before risk tags.

findings.summary: association_gap and fp_rate_gap are undefined quantities placed on one arbitrary 0.15 threshold.
findings.fix: Define each statistic/denominator/uncertainty and separate policies.

findings.summary: Case says district_code is removed and proxies mitigated without retraining/re-evaluating utility and group metrics.
findings.fix: Treat removal as candidate mitigation and rerun full evaluation.

findings.summary: Toy p±q has no empirical uncertainty/conformal basis yet a band is required as uncertainty evidence.
findings.fix: Keep toy band as visualization scaffolding; require empirical uncertainty for a real gate.

findings.summary: score_interval accepts out-of-range/nonfinite p, negative q, reversed/out-of-range bounds and rounds internally.
findings.fix: Validate finite p∈[0,1], q>0 and bounds; keep full precision internally.

findings.summary: 'Un score puntual engaña' plus q>0 can imply any nonzero band is more honest than a point estimate.
findings.fix: Say a point is incomplete when uncertainty matters; unjustified intervals are not improvements.

findings.summary: Always-0.5 calibrated predictor is called 'bad Brier' without a prevalence/reference benchmark.
findings.fix: Compare Brier to appropriate references and avoid absolute bad/good labels.

findings.summary: Extreme z is declared same-domain tail while unseen channel is domain shift; extreme values may also be shift/corruption.
findings.fix: Present these as hypotheses/signals requiring provenance checks.

findings.summary: Outcome/headline says detect OOD, but max(|z|)>thr cannot detect stated unseen categorical channel or multivariate novelty.
findings.fix: Rename as univariate range check or implement detectors for declared novelty types.

findings.summary: reference_split='train' plus assert does not prove z scores came from a train-fitted scaler; asserts can be disabled.
findings.fix: Carry scaler/reference manifest IDs and validate runtime provenance.

findings.summary: is_ood crashes on empty input, treats NaN as in-domain and accepts negative thresholds.
findings.fix: Validate non-empty finite vectors and positive finite thresholds.

findings.summary: OOD abstain is not bound to S34 frozen abstention/threshold policy, destination or capacity accounting.
findings.fix: Route OOD through the immutable decision-policy manifest/workload model.

findings.summary: Four-field 'minimum' attributed to Mitchell et al. omits major Model Cards elements such as model/version, evaluation procedures/data, factors, analyses and caveats.
findings.fix: Call four fields the lab subset and show broader framework.

findings.summary: card_ok returns True for use='fraud_label', contestability=False and empty owner if keys exist and fraud_label is out_of_scope.
findings.fix: Validate values, forbidden uses, non-empty owner and contestability semantics.

findings.summary: contestability=True is only a boolean; no appeal channel/event/status/history exists.
findings.fix: Represent contestability as a traceable process/state contract.

findings.summary: Card is not bound to actual model/version/data/evaluation metrics/threshold/calibrator/policy.
findings.fix: Persist immutable governed-model and evaluation references.

findings.summary: Outcome says case/human/by are reconstructible while T4-B admits those fields are insufficient.
findings.fix: Require the full reconstructible event fields in outcome/gate.

findings.summary: audit_event accepts empty case/human, arbitrary actions and malformed timestamps.
findings.fix: Validate identifiers, action enum, timestamp/timezone, reason and model/policy refs.

findings.summary: Lifecycle is only a printed list; no transition function prevents invalid state changes.
findings.fix: Implement allowed transition graph and persist transition events.

findings.summary: Prose says drift_flag retires preserving history, but code has no drift handling, retirement operation or history store.
findings.fix: Implement/verify retirement transition and append-only history.

findings.summary: Portfolio fields still omit event_id, prior/new state, evidence/explanation/policy refs and append-only persistence.
findings.fix: Define immutable append-only AuditEvent lineage.

findings.summary: Theory playground can print portfolio_ready=True without validating evidence, uncertainty, OOD provenance, slices, model-card completeness or audit lineage.
findings.fix: Make portfolio_ready consume validators for every required layer.

findings.summary: score, feature, slice, proxy, high-risk, mitigate, OOD, conformal, model card, contestability and override arrive rapidly with inconsistent Spanish-first definitions.
findings.fix: Introduce each term in Spanish first with role, input/output and consequence.

highest_risk_findings: S35-F01/F03 explanation and fairness artifacts inherit invalid S34 metrics/policies without frozen sample/run lineage
S35-F06/F07 permutation importance is never computed from an evaluated fitted model and lacks repeat variability
S35-F10/F12 local explanation is not bound to the real model and Theory playground mislabels derived features as observed evidence
S35-F13/F14/F16 slice analysis uses handwritten aggregates; invalid NaN support can become ok_n and uncertainty/denominators are absent
S35-F17/F18/F19 proxy risk ignores support, conflates unrelated gaps and claims mitigation without retraining/evaluation
S35-F20/F21 toy p±q can create invalid/reversed probability bands while serving as required uncertainty artifact
S35-F25/F26/F27 OOD detector cannot detect stated novelty types and treats NaN as in-domain
S35-F29/F30/F31/F32 model-card validation can pass forbidden use and no contestability, with no binding to governed model
S35-F33-F38 audit/lifecycle/playground gates are not reconstructible/enforceable and can still print green

usable: Explanation must distinguish observed evidence, model contribution, uncertainty and human decision.
Feature attribution/correlation is not causal or legal evidence.
Permutation importance is model/metric dependent and sensitive to collinearity.
low_n alone proves neither fairness nor unfairness.
Toy p±q is explicitly not conformal prediction.
Classification conformal is correctly described conceptually as prediction sets rather than regression intervals.
Univariate z-range is explicitly described as a limited heuristic, not a general OOD detector.
Abstention and human override are legitimate governance concepts when operationally specified.
misconception_risk: gap>=.15 == high-risk proxy regardless of support
four model-card keys == Mitchell et al. minimum
printed lifecycle list == governed state machine
